purpose: Measure the exact transverse tensor-AQUAL activation on every registered baryonic map and determine whether the domain separation claimed structurally in P0659 is real before opening any velocity or lensing target.
constitutive_equation: div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0) ((1-sigma) I + sigma n_hat n_hat) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_b

definitions.ell: |g_N|/||grad g_N||_F with the inherited streamline trace floor and cap
definitions.h_hat: unit gas-minus-star component-field direction, with the traced Newtonian direction as the zero-difference fallback
definitions.n_hat: the in-plane direction perpendicular to h_hat

selection_rule: The exact C_transverse primary law advances only if every predeclared gate passes. The earlier P0643 component-cancellation ratio is not accepted as evidence for this gate.
claim_boundary: P0660 tests only whether the proposed tensor coefficient is present, bounded, stable, and domain-selective on registered baryonic maps.
A pass would authorize real-map field solves and spent-outcome topology tests; it would not establish galaxy or cluster accuracy.
The thin-sheet Newtonian fields are used to construct the coefficient, not as a replacement for a three-dimensional or covariant completion.
The 10 kpc coherence length remains phenomenological and inherited rather than derived from first principles.
No P0633 velocity, P0640 lens constraint, or spent lens residual may be used in P0660 development or selection.
